title: fix(ui): Setup metadata lists take their title from the sidebar and lead with the label
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoDnVj7S3St12zLfDBXSN5gF)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Setup 里的元数据列表（岗位、权限集等）标题改用侧栏里打开它的那一项的名字，所以显示「Positions / 岗位」这类侧栏原词，而不是类型的单数名「Position」；每一行先显示标签（如 Sales Director），API 名小字等宽放在下面，不再单独占一列「Label」；描述最多两行，悬停看全文，手机上一行不再撑到 180 px 高。
- 为什么改：#27356 第 5 行（hotcrm#2320 Setup S4）：HotCRM 浏览器走查指出标题是单数、首列是 API 名、手机上行太高。
- 风险与回滚：只改 Setup 下的列表外观；同一页面在 Setup 之外（元数据目录、Studio 的「在 Setup 中打开」）完全不变；侧栏没有恰好指向本页的入口时标题退回类型名。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ResourceListPage.tsx` 里 `setupTitle` / `labelColumn`（`objectstack#27356` 注释处）与新文件 `navEntryTitle.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceListPage.setupLabelFirst-27356.test.tsx`，应见 5 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Part of #27356 (row 5, hotcrm#2320 Setup S4: Setup metadata lists read as admin lists)
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **The title is the sidebar's word for the page.** Under Setup, `ResourceListPage`'s header now takes the label of the app's own navigation entry that opens exactly this page, through the new `navEntryTitle` (`metadata-admin/navEntryTitle.ts`). The entry is elected by `@object-ui/layout`'s `resolveActiveNavItem`, the one "which menu am I in" matcher, and counts only when its own address (`resolveHref`) is this page's path; its text goes through `resolveNavItemLabel`, as the sidebar's does. Setup's Access Control entries are `type: 'url'` entries (`nav_positions` labelled "Positions", `nav_permission_sets` "Permission Sets"), served in the reader's language, so the page reads as the row that opened it in every locale the app's bundle carries. With no such entry, the title falls back to the type's label, as before. No plural table is added to the ui registry and nothing changes in `packages/spec`.
- **Label first, API name beneath.** Under Setup, when a type's first column is its primary key and it also lists `label`, the two fold into one cell: the label is the row's link, the API name sits under it in small monospace type (`metadata-row-api-name`), and the separate Label column goes. The folded column's header is the Label column's. An item with no label keeps its API name as the monospace link, as before.
- **Short rows.** Under Setup a description cell shows two lines at most (`line-clamp-2`) with the whole text in its `title`, so a long description no longer stretches a row at phone width.
- **Outside Setup nothing changes:** the directory list and Studio's "Open in Setup" target keep the API name column, the Label column, the type's label as the title and unclamped descriptions.

## Tests

- New `ResourceListPage.setupLabelFirst-27356.test.tsx` (5 tests), on the real page with the metadata client doubled as `ResourceListPage.setupPosture-12606` does and the served Setup app's navigation handed in through the expression context:
  - the header reads "Positions" from the `nav_positions` entry;
  - with no entry opening exactly this page it reads "Position";
  - a row's link is "Sales Director" (not monospace), its API name `sales_director` sits beneath, the header has one "Label" column first and no "Name" column; an unlabelled item keeps its monospace API-name link;
  - a long description carries `line-clamp-2` and its whole text as `title`;
  - CONTROL: the same page under `studio` keeps the monospace API-name link, the Name and Label columns and no clamp.
- `ResourceListPage.setupPosture-12606`: its Setup case found the row by the link name `everyone`; under Setup that link is now the label, so it finds `Everyone`. Its outside-Setup control is unchanged.

<details><summary>Readings (head 464325f7, base origin/main 9f13ee81; app-shell closure built with declarations)</summary>

- New file: 5/5 passed.
- Every ui test file naming `ResourceListPage`, `MetadataResourceListPage` or `navEntryTitle` (24 files, the AppContent route suites included): 24 passed, 294/294 tests.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (both programs): lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Ablation 1, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: `const labelColumn = inSetup && columns[0]` to `const labelColumn = false && columns[0]`: 4 failed / 1 passed (the control stays green); restored blob = HEAD blob `1abb07375086`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation 2: `(inSetup && navEntryTitle(` to `(false && navEntryTitle(`: 1 failed / 4 passed (the nav-entry title case); restored blob = HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- vitest resolves `@object-ui/*` to source, so neither ablation needed a rebuild leg.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Per-row status of #27356's Setup rows** (re-measured on `main` 9f13ee81; the Studio rows 12–22 are settled, handoff 6524323618):

  | Row | Disposition |
  |---|---|
  | 5 | **Taken here.** |
  | 11 | Taken, next PR from this thread (All reports empty state points to the apps that have reports for the reader). |
  | 10 | **Will not do on this card.** HotCRM saw Export under Display at 1440 px, not only at phone width: the bundled Display panel with Refresh and Export in its footer is the default at every width by objectui#12423's maintainer-approved design ("Refresh and Export leave the bar (they live in the Display footer)"). Moving Export back to the bar or the ⋯ menu reverses that design and needs a maintainer call. |
  | 1 | Finding, carrier `domain:server`: Create User's params are server metadata (`create_user` on `sys_user`, platform-objects; `permissionSet` is an inline `type: 'text'` param) and the create-user door accepts no position. |
  | 4 | Finding, carrier `domain:server`: `POST /automation/:name/trigger` refuses a `runAs: 'system'` schedule flow for anyone but the system principal (`flowStartRefusal`); all of HotCRM's schedule flows run as system. |
  | 6 | Finding, carrier `domain:server`: the Users row menu is `sys_user`'s server actions; there is no deactivate verb, only Ban. |
  | 7 | Finding, carrier `domain:server`: "Record ID" is `sys_approval_request`'s own field label (plugin-approvals). |
  | 8 | Finding, carrier `domain:server`: plugin-approvals knows a request opened on its fallback approvers but persists no marker a reader can show. |

  The seat files the `domain:server` cards; this PR is `Part of`, and the row 11 PR closes the card once every row is landed or answered.
- **The title follows the navigation, not a registry plural.** A list reached by a URL no Setup entry carries (a typed address, another app's link) still reads the type's singular label. That is the honest fallback: the type registry carries no plural label, and adding one is a spec change this card does not take.
- **The folded column applies only where the type lists `label`** with the primary key first; a type with its own columns (for example the field list, which leads with name then object) keeps its layout.
- Measured in happy-dom, not in a browser at 390 px: the row height on a phone was not re-measured.
